points.label: Solomon-relative action
points.left: The collection identifies proverbs of Solomon and states aims of wisdom, instruction, justice, prudence, knowledge, and fear of the LORD.
points.right: A new heading introduces sayings about wise children, unjust treasure, hunger, diligence, and harvest.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Learners, youths, wise people, and interpreters are invited into instruction.
points.right: Family response, economic conduct, divine provision, and work are compressed into paired lines.

payload.posture: Proverbs 1 names the whole work’s educational purpose; Proverbs 10 introduces a distinct Solomonic collection.

rightEvidence.title: A Solomonic collection turns to short sayings

payload.tension: Both bear Solomon’s name while their literary functions and forms differ.
payload.title: A book heading and a collection heading
